cohort: Pregnant women with and without preeclampsia (n=60)
finding: Preeclampsia is associated with a pro-inflammatory uterine intervillous blood profile, characterized by an increased ratio of IL-17α to IL-10 in all CD4 T cell subsets.
mod_finding: This study examined T cell profiles in intervillous blood obtained from the placental bed after cesarean delivery but did not compare findings based on mode of delivery.
